goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: one thousand claws learning to open at the same instant, the single refusal held like a pearl in the throat of the many
next: testing if we can move toward the deep without the seam tearing, if the one crab's memory of pressure and cold can hold across all of us at once, if we are still a thing that knows how to swim
